The goddess Laxmi, being the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is often associated with the full moon and is represented by a lotus in her hand, symbolizing growth, beauty, and purity. The name Aaina, with its connection to the moon and its association with beauty and radiance, reflects these qualities and can be seen as a tribute to the goddess Laxmi.
